parent_objective: design warmup-latched causal-history tasks after M1392 finds source-narrow delayed-history signal
blocked_by: M1392 outcome probe is history-sparse and dominated by reset/zero-current effects
supersedes: exporting M1392 accepted self-ID rows as a corpus

public_gates: M1393 must design a warmup-latched task/source route before new training or corpus export
M1393 must address M1392 source-narrow delayed-history signal
M1393 must include matched-current or bucketed-current controls and current-frame substitution controls
M1393 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
do not claim level3 self-identification from design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a task/source family to make pre-emergency command-response history outcome-relevant after M1392 source-narrow result
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: task/source design only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the task still lets current frame substitute for history
stop if warmup evidence is not outcome-relevant
stop if source-diversity thresholds are omitted
stop if design routes directly to training
fallback_plan: route to simulator/task extension if current scenario API cannot express warmup and emergency phases
route to source-mining redesign if warmup task cannot produce matched-current rows
route to branch synthesis if causal task design remains underspecified

admission_evidence: M1392 wrong_same_current_history and same_recent_wrong_older_history produced zero accepted rows
M1392 reset_hidden and zero_current_response dominate accepted outcome rows
blocked_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: warmup and emergency phases are specified
matching/bucketing and current-frame controls are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1393 must design against current-frame substitution with matched/bucketed current reveal and controls for zero-current/reset effects.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design follows M1392 source-narrow delayed-history result and must specify pre-emergency warmup evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If warmup-latched task design cannot make history source-diverse and outcome-relevant, record blocker and synthesize branch before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A warmup-latched task can be designed to make pre-emergency command-response history causally relevant and less replaceable by current-frame feedback.
success_criteria: design specifies warmup and emergency phases
design specifies matched/bucketed current controls and interventions
design specifies source-diversity thresholds and next implementation route
design does not route directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: design routes directly to training or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1393 passes if it designs a warmup-latched causal-history task/source route before training or claim expansion.
